As some of you are aware, I am the newly appointed head mod of v/football. I was made a mod here around a month ago by the previous head mod, and since then I have made several small changes to the sub to stimulate growth and interaction. I have removed the old CSS, organised the sidebar and started an official fantasy football league. However, with the inactivity of the head mod, I felt confined in how much I could do to improve the sub. I therefore decided to make a claim for the sub, which was approved by @PuttItOut yesterday. My first act was to remove the other inactive mods, with the exception of the previous head mod, @whiteguy88. I hope he will become an active member of the sub once again and prove a valuable member of the mod team. My second act was to bring in @Boukert and @PM_ME_YOUR_ARCHES as a mods. They are both large contributors to the sub and both have substantial mod experience.

This sub deserves better than the treatment it has received in the past six months. It deserves to be active. It deserves a vibrant community. Hopefully, we can now start to move to that ideal. However, we need your feedback on what you want this sub to be. I have a few ideas of where I would like to take the sub, but I would like to hear your ideas on what the future holds for v/football. If you could comment on the following points below it would be very helpful.

Rules:

Right now there are no rules for the sub. Personally, I don't have an issue with this, I don't see a need for them right now. Rules can always be added if the situation arises. Are there any rules you would like us to consider?

Content:

Are you happy with the content on the sub? What sort of content do you like to see?

CSS:

What would you like to see in terms of CSS? Are there any features you would like to see e.g flairs? Anything you want us to avoid?

Interactivity:

We have recently set up a fantasy football league. Would you like to see more of this kind of interactivity? Would you like to see any other subverse wide games or activities?

If you have any other concerns or suggestions, please comment below.
